notes: For fix-index (I could not reach it with SendMessage; please relay): in src/index.js, scopeSql('path') in list_notes is broken because json_each has a hidden column named `path`, so an unqualified `path` inside the EXISTS subquery binds to j.path ('$'). I confirmed this with a direct node:sqlite query in sbx, and verify-21's list_notes for a project:alpha key now returns [] where it used to return alpha.md. Fix: alias the table (FROM notes n) and use scopeSql('n.path'). app.js uses f.path and is not affected.

Full suite (/target/test/*.test.mjs, 5 files) in sbx: 44 of 46 pass. All 15 of my tests pass, as do Group A's. The 2 failures are fix-index's own tests in test/index.test.mjs:229 and :242 ('src/index.js:search:sql-limit-before-scope-filter ...'), which get [] for scoped searches. That is fix-index's in-progress code, not mine.

Smoke test in sbx (scratch/smoke.mjs) imports the real worker. POST /app/login with a 3-day read key scoped to vault/projects/ returns 302 with Max-Age=259199, which is capped at the key's expiry. /app/api/graph returns 200 with only the 2 visible nodes and 1 edge. /app/api/check returns 200 with counts notes 2 / links 2 and the out-of-scope target reported as broken. /app/api/keys returns 403 and /health returns 200.
Group A's note is handled: /app/login now writes exp = min(now+30d, key.expires), and the cookie Max-Age is capped the same way. Root and non-expiring keys keep +30 days.

Hardening: the brain_session cookie regex is anchored to (?:^|;\s*). NoteView now uses react-markdown's defaultUrlTransform, letting only the brain: and brain-dead: wikilink schemes through, instead of the identity transform. CSP, X-Frame-Options and nosniff were not added because app.js produces no HTML responses (only JSON, redirects and plain text).

Behaviour changes: CRLF skills.md rows are now accepted (trimEnd strips the '\r'). Wikilinks whose target contains '[' no longer match, and '[[[x]]]' now resolves to 'x'. The hygiene counts for a scoped principal are now scoped instead of vault-wide.
